g.text: Non-overlapping groups: overdue first, then status. Blocked work stays visible.
└ TRK-47 Validate owner callback Ready High
Aggregated scope: all sections + project root
Manual reorder unavailable across sections. Select a single section to reorder.
Filters and view selection remain in URL state; sorting does not rewrite ranks.
Column order follows workflow. Drag changes status; menu alternative remains available.
Desktop ≥1440 inline; 1024–1439 overlay. Back restores the list state.
Restrict sign-in to the provisioned GitHub identity.
Open full page for long notes and stable deep links. Activity and integrations continue below.
Optional properties: due date, labels, description, parent task. C opens outside editors.

PR #24 Owner sign-in · Open · not draft

PR merged never means Done. Owner validates completion.
An integration outage preserves local task content and shows cached freshness.
Move carries subtasks; cannot move between projects or add a third task level.
